scope: M1 through M5 and R1 through R4 browser E2E

tests.name: M5 invoice metadata and PDF isolate participants and never create a second placement
M5 non-hired and unknown IDs have no invoice
M5 notification cursor and runtime RLS expose only recipient organization and always unsent
M5 full browser flow reaches invoice and unsent notification without sending mail
M5 long Japanese and escaped names remain one page with complete names in metadata
M5 renderer outage fails closed and browser offers retry
M5 revoked share removes employer PDF and plaintext while agency retains invoice
M5 internal renderer refuses missing key and caller-controlled HTML URL or extra schema
M5 expired session clears invoice metadata and rendered blob
S2 real broker AV format sandbox, live isolation probes and encrypted manifest
S2 native Sheets XLSX follows real AV and one job per fresh sandbox
S2 corrupted GCM tag never reaches AV or parser; terminal outcome is retained
S2 scanner outage refuses, retains accepted ID and recovers in a new generation
S2 original/artifact revocation persists across restart, blocks leased decrypt and commit
S2 ownership archive and stale lease fencing deny decryption; expired worker recovers
S2 worker role cannot issue arbitrary DB queries; public gateway does not expose control
S2 rotation retains old original and artifact keys and restores encrypted manifests
S2 real malware and invalid format are terminal without making documents usable
S2 browser encrypted intake remains unavailable after checking and page reload
S2 missing original key permission refuses and restored old material resumes same document
S2 actual broker process loss is fenced and resumes after lease expiry without another upload
S2 invoice and original inspection routes reject the opposite service purpose
S2 idle worker has no job, performs no decryption and stops cleanly

secrets_policy: No trace, video, storageState, network dump or failure screenshot. Diagnostics redact credentials and URLs.
